shell.title: Notification center
shell.subtitle: Create rules that notify your team automatically — when data changes or on a schedule — and track how they perform.
overview.emptyText: Triggers decide when a notification is sent, to whom, and through which channel. Create your first one, or read the guide first.
list.search: Search by name, table or type…
list.errorText: The server did not respond as expected. Check your connection and try again.
list.noMatchText: Try a different search or clear the filters.
list.emptyText: Create a trigger to start sending notifications automatically.
list.noNextHint: Active but the scheduler has no next run. Save the trigger again to re-schedule it.
type.dbHint: Fires when a row is inserted, updated or deleted in a table.
type.scheduledHint: Fires at a set time — once, daily, weekly, monthly or on a cron.
channel.inAppHint: Adds the notification to each user's bell list.
channel.pushHint: Phones and browsers with a registered device.
channel.emailHint: Requires an email sender configured on the server.
channel.smsHint: No SMS provider is connected yet.
delete.title: Delete this trigger?
delete.message: “{name}” will stop sending notifications and its run history will be removed. Notifications already delivered are kept. This can't be undone.
unsaved.title: Discard your changes?
unsaved.message: You have unsaved changes on this trigger. If you leave now they will be lost.
form.duplicatedInfo: Copied from “{name}”. It starts paused — review it and switch it on when ready.
form.s1Text: Name the trigger so you can recognise it later.
form.s3Text: Write what recipients will read. Use {{Field}} to insert values from the changed row.
form.s4Text: Pick the recipients. Be specific — a broad audience means many notifications.
form.s5Text: Choose where the notification appears. At least one channel is required.
form.saveFailed: The trigger could not be saved.
f.name: Name
f.nameHint: Shown in the admin lists, e.g. “New code created”.
f.tableHint: The physical database table name (e.g. users, codes) — not the C# class.
f.conditionsHint: Optional. Clauses joined by AND — operators: == != > < >= <= contains changed. Leave empty to fire on every matching change.
f.cronHint: Quartz syntax with seconds: sec min hour day-of-month month day-of-week. One of the two day fields must be “?”. Runs in UTC.
f.startWeeklyHint: Weekly runs on this date's weekday (Cairo time). Defaults to Monday. Your time zone: {tz}.
f.startMonthlyHint: Monthly runs on this date's day of the month (max 28). Defaults to the 1st. Your time zone: {tz}.
f.endHint: Optional. The trigger stops after this moment.
f.typeHint: A short code clients use to pick an icon or screen, e.g. CodeCreated. Letters, digits and . _ : - only.
f.title: Title
f.arHint: Optional. When empty, the English text is used for Arabic users.
f.advanced: Advanced: links, extra data and attachments
f.redirectHint: Where a click should lead. Keys: web, mobile.
f.dataMappingHint: Key/value pairs added to the push payload. Values can use {{Field}}.
f.hasFileHint: A template that resolves to true or 1 when there is a file.
f.rolesHint: Comma-separated role names, e.g. Admin, Dispatcher.
f.usersHint: Comma-separated user ids or {{Field}} values from the changed row, e.g. {{OwnerId}}, 5.
f.connectionHint: Optionally limit to users who are online (connected to the live hub) or offline right now.
f.pushTargetHint: Mobile = push to registered devices · Web = instantly in open browser tabs · Both.
target.rolesHint: Everyone who has one of the chosen roles.
target.usersHint: Fixed ids, or the user found in the changed row.
sum.title: Summary
sum.monthly: Day {day} of every month at {time} (Cairo time)
warn.everyoneDb: This notifies every user on each matching change. Consider roles or specific users.
warn.updateNoCond: UPDATE without conditions fires on every update of any row in the table.
warn.oncePast: The run time is in the past — a “Once” trigger will not fire again.
warn.endPast: The end date has passed, so this trigger will not run.
warn.email: Email needs an email sender configured on the server; until then nothing is delivered by email.
preview.title: Live preview
preview.arFallback: No Arabic text yet — Arabic users will see the English text.
preview.wouldFire: This sample row would fire the trigger.
preview.wouldNot: This sample row would not fire the trigger
preview.scheduledNa: Scheduled triggers don't depend on a row — only the text is previewed.
preview.sampleHint: Use field names as keys. Add an “Old” object for previous values on UPDATE.
v.badTable: Use the table name only: letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
v.badCron.fields: A Quartz cron needs 6 or 7 fields (seconds first).
v.badCron.value: One of the cron fields has an invalid value.
v.badCron.dayConflict: Set exactly one of day-of-month / day-of-week to “?”.
v.badConditions: Can't read “{clause}”. Use {{Field}} == 'value' — operators: == != > < >= <= contains changed.
v.conditionsOr: OR isn't supported. Join clauses with AND, or create a second trigger for the other case.
v.badTemplate: A {{Field}} placeholder is incomplete. Check the braces.
v.futureDate: Pick a time in the future.
v.endBeforeStart: The end date must be after the start date.
v.needsChannel: Turn on at least one channel: in-app, push or email.
v.needsFileUrl: An attachment URL is required when “Has attachment” is set.
guide.templates.title: Templates
guide.templates.text: Titles, messages and redirects can include {{Field}} placeholders. They are replaced with values from the row that fired the trigger. {{Old.Field}} is the previous value on UPDATE; {{Table}}, {{Operation}} and {{Now}} are always available.
guide.conditions.title: Conditions
guide.conditions.text: Only fire when the row matches. Join clauses with AND. Numbers are compared numerically, text ignores case. “changed” is true when that column was modified. A clause the server can't read stops the trigger from firing.
guide.targets.title: Recipients
guide.targets.text: Choose roles, or specific user ids. Ids may come from the row itself, e.g. the owner of a record. Pick “Everyone” only for announcements.
guide.schedule.title: Schedules
guide.schedule.text: Daily, Weekly and Monthly use Cairo time. Weekly uses the weekday of the start date; Monthly its day of the month. Cron expressions use Quartz syntax and run in UTC. The scheduler keeps jobs in memory and reloads them when the server starts.
guide.extras.title: Redirect & extra data
guide.extras.text: Redirect data tells clients where to go when the notification is opened. Extra data is added to the push payload so the app can act on it.
guide.channels.title: Channels
guide.channels.text: In-app stores the notification in each user's list. Push goes to devices registered with Firebase. “Web” delivers instantly to open browser tabs over the live connection. Email needs a server-side sender. Each channel is independent.
